findings.evidence: `rg -n 'def IsFaithful|isFaithful_basis_independent' code/TauCeti/Algebra/AlgebraicGroup/Representation/Faithful.lean` finds the basis-indexed definition at line 100 and its basis-independence theorem at line 115; the roadmap requires faithfulness of a representation, not of a based representation.
findings.fix: Define a basis-free `IsFaithful` on the comodule (using the intrinsic coefficient-and-antipode generation condition), and expose a theorem characterizing it as `IsClosedImmersion (groupSchemeMap b)` for every finite basis.
findings.issue: `IsFaithful` takes `b : Basis (Fin n) R M`, so every downstream statement must carry arbitrary basis data even though lines 105–119 prove the property depends only on the comodule.

summary: Faithfulness is exposed as a property of a chosen basis rather than the represented comodule, despite being intrinsically basis-independent.
